description: A power-set quotient modulo an ideal has only one element exactly when the full carrier belongs to the ideal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.quotient_subsingleton_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α)) :
  Subsingleton (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.SmallQuotient I) ↔ Set.univ ∈ I
